explanation: Current state: 95 systems fall within PCI scope across 233 data-flow clusters; 2 circular dependency cluster(s) were resolved into the DAG. Of these, 44 are confirmed by authoritative BAM metadata and 51 are inferred-only candidate scope surfaced from survey/Splunk signals (kept separate, never treated as ground truth). The widest PAN distributor is 6CWC, reaching 29 downstream systems; the highest-leverage single tokenization target is 6CWC. Because the same downstream systems are fed by several PAN sources, no single source frees many on its own — so the optimizer selects the minimal set. Tokenizing the recommended source(s) descopes 27 systems (28.4% of the in-scope surface), converts 2 source(s) from live PAN to non-transactable tokens, and lowers the aggregate risk score by 17.9% — the clean-stream effect.

agents.name: Supervisor / Orchestrator
agents.role: Owns graph state, routing, retries, and the human approval gate.
agents.method: LangGraph StateGraph — explicit nodes, checkpointed, resumable.

agents.name: Ingestion & Sanitiser
agents.role: Loads the CSV exports, validates schema, and masks PAN on entry.
agents.method: PAN masked to first-6/last-4 at the boundary; nothing unmasked passes.

agents.name: Masking-Leak Validator
agents.role: Fails the entire run if any unmasked PAN escapes ingestion.
agents.method: Luhn + pattern scan across every ingested cell; raises on any leak.

agents.name: Graph Builder
agents.role: Builds the system interdependency graph of cardholder-data flow.
agents.method: Typed MultiDiGraph; metadata (BAM) vs inferred (survey/Splunk) edges kept distinct.

agents.name: Cycle Resolver
agents.role: Surfaces circular dependencies, then condenses them into a DAG.
agents.method: Tarjan strongly-connected components -> condensation; acyclicity asserted.

agents.name: Quant / Scoring
agents.role: Assigns each system a defensible composite risk score.
agents.method: sensitivity x reachability x betweenness (Brandes) x true-source; bounded 0-100.

agents.name: Core Analyst
agents.role: Computes PCI scope, heavy hitters, clean-stream impact, and hidden scope.
agents.method: Graph reachability + exclusive-reach set logic; no black boxes.

agents.name: Human-in-the-Loop Gate
agents.role: Lets a reviewer approve, revise, or abort before anything is reported.
agents.method: LangGraph interrupt — the run genuinely pauses for a human decision.

agents.name: Reporter
agents.role: Narrates the already-computed, grounded numbers in plain language.
agents.method: LLM constrained to the computed facts only — it explains, it never decides.

plan.method: greedy max-marginal full-descope (heuristic; objective is supermodular under conjunctive true-source coverage, so no (1-1/e) guarantee)

optimization.objective: max systems fully descoped s.t. <= k true sources tokenized (supermodular AND-coverage; solved to certified optimality)

decision_memo.text: Recommended action: tokenize PAN at the true source. Tokenizing the single highest-leverage source (6CWC) alone fully descopes 2 system(s) today — small, but that is a threshold effect, not a failure. Full descope begins with the very first sources tokenized, reaching 27 at ~7.9% of the 63 sources (k=5). The recommended greedy set (6CWC, 8CCF, 8MEC) descopes 27. Scope reduction is a program that pays off as the source front is cleared, not a single switch. Exposure falls immediately, even before that threshold. Tokenizing 6CWC strips a clear-PAN feed from 29 downstream systems and reduces the true-source-parent count on 27 systems. Exposure narrows across the estate even where a system's scope status has not yet changed — this is the marginal benefit of each tokenization, and the right way to rank them. Targeting matters. Blocking the three widest conduits by betweenness (8AQB, 8BCC, 8AFN) fully descopes 0 systems, whereas tokenizing the true-source set (6CWC, 8CCF, 8MEC) descopes 27 and removes 30 clear-PAN feeds. Blocking high-traffic relays does not reduce scope; converting the systems that originate PAN does. Sequence: begin with 6CWC and proceed down the ranked true-source list; each step lowers aggregate exposure now and advances toward the descope threshold. Plan for the full true-source front to realise the larger descope. (Descopable surface: 32 of 95 in-scope systems.)

segmentation_min_cut.note: min edges to sever so no true PAN source reaches the target (max-flow/min-cut, unit capacities; Menger's theorem)
